title: Nutty Uruguayan Brussels Sprouts Wrap
description: A shattering and kid-friendly Uruguayan dish featuring Brussels sprouts, ssam-wrap, and a nutty flavor. Serve warm with a side of tangy salsa.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of peanut oil and swirl to coat the pan.
Add the Brussels sprouts and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are tender and caramelized, about 8 minutes.
In a separate pan, warm the ssam-wrap over medium heat for 30 seconds on each side.
